name: Logtrics
free_limit: 1,000,000 logs/crashes/events per month; 30-day retention; 1 app; 1 team member; email alerts; 3 AI RCA and 3 AI Session Summaries per month
watch_out: Free is limited to 1 app, 1 team member, 30-day retention, and 3 AI RCA plus 3 AI Session Summaries per month. Provider pricing says it notifies users approaching the 1M monthly log/event quota and offers paid extra log capacity at $10 per 50M logs/month; it does not establish a guaranteed hard stop for Free. Confirm over-quota enforcement before relying on it for production cost protection; do not assume paid capacity is automatically purchased on Free.
